column1: # The L1 EXPECTED census - charter § 4 (anti-trivialisation bar: every row a
# deliberate-by-design reason code; an expander artefact is NEVER admissible).
# Ratified at PR-1 review and FROZEN; growth = a new review.
# RE-RATIFIED for chaos-1.1.0 (v3.2 seat 10, PR #631 - D49): derived from the
# l1-s10-run7 dump (oracle 9.83.0, 988 files, records=23875, 104 error rows over
# 45 files; run8 byte-identical - the dump is deterministic x2; run5/run6 the
# same rows at 987 files before s99 joined and the s24 / s27 re-admission edits,
# run3/run4 at 986 before s98), every row printed by
# target/v32-seat10-instruments/derive-expectations-s10.py (local) and copied
# here with its reason code - never typed; the gate receipt:
# target/chaos-expander/logs/l1-gate-s10-run7.txt (local). Every EXPECTED file
# is ALSO judged ALONE once by pin-chaos-goldens.sh --judge-alone (the seat-9
# exclusion class retired; the verdicts in judged-alone.tsv), as is every
# MOJO-REFUSED file of mojo-refused.tsv (the § 4b two-oracles class: L1-clean,
# generator-refused - s98's `empty as-key`).
# file<TAB>reason-code<TAB>expected-message-substring<TAB>rows
#   rows = the PINNED kind-count multiset (e.g. LINKERR=1,VALIDERR=1)
#   claimed by that row's substring - the cq review's MF-1: a silent
#   heal OR growth of any occurrence is a verdict change (LAW 73).
#   '-' on ORACLE-CLEAN rows (zero error rows asserted).
# THE FORK-SIDE HALVES (charter § 4b): the per-file fork data's single source
# of truth is fork-diagnostics.tsv, asserted live by ChaosForkDiagnosticsGateTest
